Tools > Export Personal Data > Download personal data (UI) ran and produced a zip; its report lists Jetonomy Pro: Private Messages (7), Reactions (10), Custom Fields (2), Badges (11), Poll Votes (3), Push Devices (Browser subscription) each with real values (e.g. Emoji=thumbsup On=Reply #3812; Badge=Early Adopter Tier=silver; Timezone/Location=Lagos, Nigeria). e-pro-privacy-and-abilities.9.evidence: Now re-walked: wp_get_abilities lists 39 jetonomy abilities (Free 19 + Pro 20): Pro includes send-message, list-conversations, get-conversation, get-analytics, export-analytics, create-poll, vote-poll, get-poll-results, list-badges, get-user-badges, award-badge, list-webhooks, create-webhook, delete-webhook, add-reaction, get-reactions, list-custom-fields, set-custom-field, list-moderation-rules, create-moderation-rule (the earlier fail expected reactions and custom-fields abilities: they exist). Polls off -> 0 poll abilities (39 -> 36); WPMediaVerse active -> 3 messaging abilities gone (36); licence lapsed past grace -> 0 Pro abilities. Restored.

e-pro-privacy-and-abilities.4.evidence: Tools > Erase Personal Data for Jamal (demo member, confirmed request, UI button): final text 'All of the personal data found for this user was erased. Jetonomy: Topics and replies anonymized. Personal data deleted. Jetonomy Pro: Messages anonymized. Reactions, custom fields, badges, poll votes, and push subscriptions/devices deleted.' Afterwards Jamal has 0 reactions, 0 poll votes, 0 badges, 0 push rows, 0 field values, 0 messages as sender. Screenshot priv-erase.png.
